name: GoodDollar GoodFundManager collectInterest double-count
summary: GoodFundManager.collectInterest accepted duplicated staking-contract entries and double-counted them to over-claim COMP rewards routed through Compound.
notes: The third and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected GoodFundManager implementation 0x4a37a8d7cdb43d89b4dbd7ecfaeaf9bd39e24929.

The receipt records 258.031203709042906285 COMP sent to the beneficiary after that address supplied 7.4 COMP, for an exact net increase of 250.631203709042906285 COMP. The commit-pinned reproduction reports this as approximately 250 COMP and $13,000.
